0022600178.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-6, 3rd in the Central and 12th in the East) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-1, 2nd in the Southwest and 2nd in the West), who have played seven games this season and are on a one-game losing streak after winning six of their last seven. Indiana is out Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard, Kelly Oubre Jr., Larry Nance Jr., and Pascal Siakam are listed as day-to-day, while Memphis has Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) listed as day-to-day. The two teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis beat Indiana 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026, the Pacers' last meeting, after Indiana lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2.
